test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered i and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All chairs are desks.

All desks are table.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some table are chairs.

II. All tables are desk.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/379c41d1ace2ddbb0d38494407981979423b950c93d6db24d56df9b80949faa9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some table are chairs → **True** (Because all chairs are tables).

II. All tables are desk → **False** (Because all desk are table, so it is not possible)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows"**.
